inclusions.text: Private vehicle, exclusive to your party
inclusions.source: What distinguishes it from a taxi or a shared service is the comfort of a private vehicle, exclusive to your party, a fixed pickup from your Luxor hotel, one bottle of mineral water per person, and three clearly defined service levels that let you travel as sparely or as fully as you like.

inclusions.text: Transfer Only: the drive and the mandatory road permit
inclusions.source: The three levels are Transfer Only (the drive and the mandatory road permit), Transfer + Guide (adding a licensed Egyptologist for the temple stops), and Transfer + Guide & Entrance Fees (adding admission to Edfu and Kom Ombo).
